description: This file defines structures, constants, and function prototypes related to Bloom filters used in Git's commit graph for efficient commit lookup.

classes.name: bloom_filter_settings
classes.description: Configuration parameters for Bloom filters, including hash version, number of hashes, bits per entry, and max changed paths.

classes.name: bloom_filter
classes.description: Represents a Bloom filter data segment, including data pointer, length, version, and a pointer for memory management.

classes.name: bloom_key
classes.description: Holds hash values for a string, used for testing membership in Bloom filters.

classes.name: bloom_keyvec
classes.description: A vector of bloom_keys, used to store multiple keys for a path.

methods.name: load_bloom_filter_from_graph
methods.description: Loads a Bloom filter from a commit graph at a specified position.

methods.name: bloom_key_fill
methods.description: Fills a bloom_key with hash values derived from input data.

methods.name: bloom_key_clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a bloom_key.

methods.name: bloom_keyvec_new
methods.description: Creates a new bloom_keyvec for a given path, generating keys for each prefix.

methods.name: bloom_keyvec_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a bloom_keyvec.

methods.name: add_key_to_filter
methods.description: Adds a bloom_key to a bloom_filter based on settings.

methods.name: get_or_compute_bloom_filter
methods.description: Retrieves or computes a Bloom filter for a commit, with options for recomputation.

methods.name: get_bloom_filter
methods.description: Retrieves the Bloom filter for a specific commit if available.

methods.name: bloom_filter_contains
methods.description: Checks if a Bloom filter contains a specific key.

methods.name: bloom_filter_contains_vec
methods.description: Checks if all keys in a key vector are in the Bloom filter.

methods.name: test_bloom_murmur3_seeded
methods.description: Tests a data string against a seeded Murmur3 hash with a specific version.
